meta.currency_note: GLOBAL mean delta cross-entropy per valid held position -- the only common scale for headroom, joint-234 and sum-of-singles. Census TRIGGER-dCE (path-specific top-200 positions) is reported as a secondary single-path view but is NOT summable onto the global headroom.
meta.interaction_caveat: H = named_joint + (J-named_joint) + (H-J) is exact telescoping algebra; the interpretation of each term as an independent contribution carries the usual mean-ablation interaction caveat.

ledger.currency: GLOBAL mean delta cross-entropy per valid held position (nats); paired standard error over positions

full_headroom.desc: all attention heads + all full MLP outputs mean-ablated (per-position mean) minus full model

mlp_full.desc: all full MLP outputs only (attn intact)

mlp_top72.desc: all 72 top-SVD MLP directions only (attn intact)

mlp_below_top72.desc: MLP effect below the top-72 SVD dirs = mlp_full - mlp_top72 (paired)

joint_234.desc: all 162 head-paths + all 72 top-SVD mlp dirs ablated simultaneously

single_path_sum_global.desc: sum over 234 paths of max(0, per-path GLOBAL-dCE) [census]

non_axis_aligned_residual.desc: full_headroom - joint_234; superposition / sub-top-72 mlp; NOT captured by any single head-pathway or top-SVD dir. Since the 162 head-paths ablate ALL attention identically in H and J, this residual is EXACTLY the MLP effect below the top-72 SVD directions, measured in the attention-ablated context. The SAME subspace measured with attention INTACT (mlp_below_top72) is larger (see field) -- the two differ by mean-ablation interaction, not by which directions are removed.

not_found_fraction_of_headroom.desc: 1 - named_joint/full_headroom = fraction of the layers causal work NOT yet characterized (= unnamed_axis_aligned + non_axis_aligned_residual)

named_fraction_of_single_path_total.desc: fraction of the summed positive single-path effect that is NAMED (axis-aligned single-path view)

unnamed_easy_vs_hard.desc: of the UNNAMED (not-in-NAMED_CORE) positive single-path importance, fraction sitting in the LOW-cleanliness (hard) region (cleanliness < p75-of-maggated) vs HIGH-cleanliness (easy)
